This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. The [[humanoid]] species was distinguished by their [[Monkey|ape]]-like faces.<ref name="TPM" /> By [[32 BBY]]<ref name="EP1Date">{{FilmDate|I}}</ref> until at least [[22 BBY]],<ref name="EP2Date">{{FilmDate|II}}</ref> four members of this species were associated with the [[Galactic Senate]].<ref name="TPM" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars:'' Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="TPM" /> When asked about this species, [[Leland Chee]] revealed that he had no additional information regarding them, going as far as to state he lumped them together with other unidentified species only ever seen in the far background of the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] under one entry within the [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Discord">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-09-23|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1420092823541387354|archivefile=File:SenateSpecies-HolocronSpecies.png}}</ref>
